review: No chorus field; one 16-line stanza (Psalm 103:1-3). Uses the biblical wording with feminine suffixes addressing the soul (עֲוֺנֹתַיִךְ, תַּחֲלֻמָיִךְ, גְּמוּלָיו) per Ps 103. The Arabic repeats "all your sins / all your diseases" and the whole 1:1-1:7 block — the repeats are kept exactly. Tetragrammaton avoided because the Arabic prints الرب, not يَهْوَه (glossary rule). 1:1/1:5/1:10/1:14 repeat verbatim like the Arabic.
